summary: Frontend regression passed for the mobile navigation fix and desktop Forecast navigation. At 390px the editorial menu is viewport-contained, mobile Forecast closes without changing horizontal geometry, storm-glass motion layers render, and no page error elements were found.
critical_code_review_comments: Weather values and partly-cloudy condition remain intentionally MOCKED; no live weather API is connected.
The partly-cloudy state is hard-coded in data-weather-state; future live-condition integration must drive that attribute and effect intensity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 390px verified main x=0, hero x=16, hero width=358, body scrollWidth=390 before and after mobile Forecast. Mobile nav x=0 width=390 and all five labels readable. Verified 14 rain streaks, partly-cloudy state, globeSpin and lightningPulse animations, and desktop Forecast targetY=104.5 after scrolling.
rca of the issue: Previous mobile inline scrolling regression is resolved by bypassing vertical navigation on viewports <=600px and restoring the main content left inset after closing the menu. Desktop uses explicit window.scrollTo and remains functional.
